svg.title: DART architecture
svg.desc: DART encodes the image once with the ViT-H backbone, caches a text embedding per class prompt, decodes all prompts in one batched encoder-decoder pass, merges per-class outputs with class-wise NMS, and pipelines the two TensorRT engines across video frames.
svg.text: Tokens by 256 channels. New classes re-encode only these.
DECODE EVERY PROMPT IN ONE BATCH
19 ms for 4 prompts, second TensorRT FP16 engine
Per-class outputs, one per batch element

text.tspan: The engines run on separate CUDA streams, so frame
+1 is encoded. At 4 classes and 1008 px this gives 15.8 FPS, against 13.8 FPS when the stages run back to back.
